tools.name: list_languages
tools.description: List language enum values and per-language voice support levels. Parameters: none; aliases: none.

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Get CargoVox and legal company information. Parameter lang; alias: language.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Get product functions, voice support by language, and Autopilot in-call quotes from the customer's uploaded tariff tables. Parameter lang; alias: language.

tools.name: get_use_cases
tools.description: Get use cases, with transport/logistics first. Parameters: lang (alias language), industry (aliases service, category).

tools.name: get_plans
tools.description: Get CargoVox subscription plan limits and pricing-on-request; these are not caller quotes, which use the customer's tariff table. Parameter lang; alias: language.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Search published FAQ; no match returns an empty list. Parameters: lang (alias language), query (alias topic).

tools.name: get_integrations
tools.description: Get webhook and named CRM integrations. Parameter lang; alias: language.

tools.name: create_inquiry
tools.description: Submit a sales or CargoVox subscription-pricing inquiry. Parameter lang has alias language; all other parameters have no aliases. TEST/TESTAS prefixes or test=true block outbound delivery.
